rules: Every pinned declaration and member/overload/type row appears in the generated report, including unassessed rows.
Unassessed is a tracking gap, not a claim that existing code is absent.
Passed criteria describe named local workflows under their documented bounds. They do not qualify a whole API.
Test totals are regression evidence, not API completion percentages. Never erase remaining contracts when landing a slice.
Frozen 1.141.0 audit artifacts remain unchanged. Reconcile prior implementations into this live ledger incrementally.

next_batch.name: Ordered public resource edits (scope retained)
criteria: Public create → text edit → rename → text edit → delete runs through the native ordered controller.
Original caller/model/resource/settings proofs authorize effects; annotation review and will-file participants run at the proper boundary.
Dirty shared/hidden models, conditional destination identity, retired history/views and recovery archives preserve unsaved work.
Mirrors and genuine operation events precede success; public Undo/Redo follows file-group semantics separately from internal rollback.
Malformed or unsupported late edit kinds never cause a silently applied supported prefix; partial physical failures have truthful receipts.
Named data-integrity tests, an actual public terminal journey, required formatting and strict Clippy pass on one recorded source/binary cohort.
